# DataVision AI

> DataVision AI is a free, AI-powered data analytics and visualization platform. Users upload CSV or Excel files, ask questions in plain English, and instantly receive interactive charts and data insights — no coding required.

## What DataVision AI Does

- Upload CSV, XLS, or XLSX datasets directly into a chat interface
- Ask natural language questions like "Show me sales trends by month" or "Which category has the highest revenue?"
- Get instant, interactive Plotly charts and AI-generated data summaries
- Supports multiple simultaneous conversations, each with its own dataset context
- Powered by DataVision AI for data analysis and chart generation

## Who It's For

- Business analysts who need quick insights without SQL
- Researchers who want to visualize experimental data
- Students exploring datasets for academic projects
- Non-technical teams who work with spreadsheets
- Developers who want to integrate AI analytics via API

## Key Features

- **Natural Language Queries**: No SQL or formulas needed
- **Interactive Charts**: Zoom, pan, hover on all generated visualizations
- **CSV & Excel Support**: Drag and drop any spreadsheet file
- **Multi-Conversation**: Manage multiple datasets simultaneously
- **API Access**: Generate API keys to integrate DataVision into your own projects
- **Secure**: Data processed locally, raw rows never stored on servers
- **Free Tier**: 1,000 analysis credits on sign-up

## Technology

- Frontend: Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind CSS
- AI Engine: DataVision AI (via backend)
- Auth: Supabase + Google OAuth
- Charts: Plotly.js (fully interactive)
- Backend: Python (FastAPI)

## Pricing

Free tier available with 100 credits. No credit card required to sign up.
